verdict.rationale: Pylon's MCP integration authenticates via OAuth and scopes agent access to 'the data you can see in Pylon,' implying some inherent least-privilege scoping tied to user permissions, and admins can define Custom API tools for agent connectors. However, there is no documented mechanism for issuing distinct, fine-grained API credentials/keys with configurable scopes specifically for agents (e.g., read-only vs. write, resource-level restrictions) beyond the OAuth-user-permission inheritance. Missing for 10: explicit scoped API key/token creation UI or docs, granular permission controls per agent, and independent verification of scope enforcement.
